UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user account metadata for Math Speedster cloud sync. Strictly isolated to the owning user to protect PII.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Short display label shown on the user profile and leaderboard.

email.description: Authenticated user email address (PII, strictly owner-only).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp recorded at profile creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp updated on profile modification.

SessionRecord.title: SessionRecord
SessionRecord.description: Immutable record of a completed Math Speedster drill session stored in the user's private history subcollection.

sessionType.description: Session structure (timed sprint, streak survival, or untimed practice).

durationSec.description: Configured timer limit in seconds (0 for untimed modes, 30/60/90 for timed sprint).

elapsedSec.description: Actual elapsed play time in seconds.

score.description: Total correct answers scored in the session.

bestStreak.description: Longest consecutive correct streak during the session.

avgResponseMs.description: Mean response latency per attempted question in milliseconds.

allowNegatives.description: Whether negative subtraction answers were enabled.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp recorded when the session was saved.

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public personal-best score entry per user and configuration bucket. Contains zero PII.

displayName.description: Non-PII public display name shown on the leaderboard.

durationSec.description: Configured duration bucket in seconds (0, 30, 60, or 90).

score.description: Personal best score for this configuration bucket.

accuracy.description: Accuracy percentage for the personal best run (0 to 100).

bestStreak.description: Longest consecutive streak achieved in this best run.

avgResponseMs.description: Average response time in milliseconds for this best run.

qpm.description: Correct answers per minute for this best run.

isPublic.description: Explicit publication marker enforced in list security rules.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial personal best record.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when personal best was last beaten.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile holding PII (email) and displayName. Readable and writable strictly by the owning user.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Private append-only history of completed mental arithmetic drills for a user.

/leaderboard/{entryId}.description: Public personal-best scoreboard entries scoped by mode, difficulty, sessionType, and durationSec. Contains zero PII.
